title: OtelAccountingProfile v1
description: The stage between an OTLP export and a NormalizedAccountingEvent. packages/schemas/producer-accounting-binding-v1.schema.json already takes an OTLP counter series to canonical token components, and packages/schemas/accounting-profile.schema.json already takes source fields to those components; neither says where the other twenty-one fields of packages/schemas/normalized-event.schema.json come from, so two collectors could agree on a token total and disagree on the event. This record names one origin and one determinism class for every top-level field of that event, so the fields that an OTLP payload cannot supply are counted rather than assumed. It also carries the metric support set and the capture-surface hazards, and both are written so that a claim needs evidence: a supported metric names a capture fixture that exists, and a disagreement with a bound authority must be declared rather than left for a reader to notice.

binding_id.description: The producer binding in conformance/accounting/producer-bindings-v1.json whose attribute policy, metric shape and reset detection this profile continues. One binding, because a derivation that read two attribute policies would have two answers for a stripped attribute.

count_authority.description: The authority the collector can attest for a count that reached it through this binding. It is the value written to NormalizedAccountingEvent.count_authority and its vocabulary is that field's.

supported_metrics.description: A metric is supported only when a capture fixture in this repository replays it. The array is compared for equality against the binding's declared metrics, so a metric can neither be claimed without a capture nor declared in the binding without appearing here.

unsupported_metrics.description: Metrics this profile knows of and does not consume. `no-capture` is the honest state for a metric a published surface describes and no fixture in this repository replays; it is not a plan and it is not partial support.

capture_surface_hazards.description: Properties of a producer's default configuration that a receiver must assume rather than hope for. Each one names what the default is, what the receiver does about it, and whether producer configuration is a control at all.

known_contradictions.description: Where this profile and another accepted authority say different things about the same field. Declaring one is not resolving it. The validator requires a declaration for every disagreement it can compute and refuses a declaration for a disagreement that no longer exists, so an entry cannot outlive its hole.

derivations.description: One entry for every top-level property of the target schema, no more and no fewer. The equality is what makes a field added to NormalizedAccountingEvent fail here until someone says where it comes from.

origin.description: Where the value comes from. `not-derivable-from-otlp` is the honest origin for a field the channel carries no fact about, and it is the one that keeps this record from reading as a complete map.

determinism.description: `deterministic` means two independent receivers of the same payload write the same value. `device-scoped` means the value is stable on one device and unreproducible off it, because a device-local key produced it. `collector-minted` means the receiver invented it. `not-observable` means the channel carries no fact and the value is a declared constant standing in for one.

blocked_by.description: A contradiction_id from known_contradictions. Present when the field cannot be written at all today.
